items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: That guy who was not Willie Helmford, he played first clarinet with us. In the Navy. I played second.

ctx.x: If you learn a number, if you learn a number and you don't need the music, well you don't have to look at it. And that's because if you know, if you learn a number and you look at it, you're not reading it, you know what I mean? You need to add it, right? One of them kind of things, but I mean it was strictly reading, see? But I mean after you learn a number, sometimes you have a solo in the number and you have to stand up to play it, but you can't be reading, you know, you have to either learn it or fake it,…

Oh yeah, you had to read. In the Navy. That guy who was not Willie Helmford, he played first clarinet with us. In the Navy. I played second. A little boy called Old Joseph, you know him? Yeah. Old Joseph, he played solo clarinet.
